## How you checked it

- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, writing check, tests, self-test)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and you saw the test fail on the old code
- [ ] A database change has a migration
- [ ] Docs are current (`docs/TASKS.md`, `docs/ISSUES.md`, `docs/DATA.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`)
- [ ] The text follows the writing rules (`make writing`)

## Security

- [ ] The change adds no key or secret
- [ ] The server does not run user code
- [ ] The code treats text from a model as untrusted
